changes.comment: chore: remove decimal() from public API (Decimal type remains exported for ExchangeRate.value). Remove CoinsError.is() static method (use instanceof CoinsError). sum() now infers currency from non-empty values; { currency } only required for empty iterables. Add rounding option to FormatOptions (default halfAwayFromZero). Add FORMAT_ERROR code for format failures (replaces mislabeled INVALID_ROUNDING/INVALID_CURRENCY). Simplify divide() sign handling for readability.
